title: VerifiedLab: Harnessing Knowns for Unknowns
abstract: arXiv:2610.37923v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Across human history, knowledge has undergone several transitions, from orality to writing and then to digital archives. At each transition, humans established new conventions to preserve knowledge for the new era. Nowadays, as research agents are increasingly deployed for laboratory experiments, knowledge is crossing another boundary: from records written for humans to those for machines. In this work, we introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent harness framework for this human-to-machine transition of knowledge. VerifiedLab transforms research output from passive artifacts into active systems that accelerate downstream use, adoption and prediction of future trends. In VerifiedLab, a team of AI scientists with distinct roles reasons over records verified field by field: a principal investigator plans, a librarian computes the evidence directly from the records, specialists draft, and a gate and a critic check each claim against the measured

translated_abstract: 纵观人类历史，知识经历了多次转变：从口述到文字，再到数字档案。在每一次转变中，人类都建立了新的惯例来为新时代保存知识。如今，随着研究智能体越来越多地被部署于实验室实验，知识正在跨越另一道边界：从为人类书写的记录转向为机器书写的记录。在本工作中，我们提出了 VerifiedLab，一个面向知识从人类向机器转变的多智能体框架。VerifiedLab 将研究成果从被动的产物转变为能够加速下游使用、采纳以及预测未来趋势的主动系统。在 VerifiedLab 中，一支由具有不同角色的 AI 科学家组成的团队对逐字段验证过的记录进行推理：首席研究员负责规划，图书管理员直接从记录中计算证据，领域专家负责起草，而一个门控和一个评论者则对照实测数据核查每一条论断……
tldr: VerifiedLab 提出了一个多智能体框架，通过分工明确的 AI 科学家团队（规划、证据计算、起草、审核）对逐字段验证的研究记录进行推理，将研究成果从被动的知识产物转变为可主动加速下游使用、采纳与未来趋势预测的主动系统。
en_tdlr: VerifiedLab is a multi-agent harness framework that transforms research outputs from passive artifacts into active systems, where AI scientists with distinct roles reason over field-by-field verified records to accelerate downstream use, adoption, and prediction of future trends.
